_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - this is a shape reference, not content. Which biomes a run passes through, in
what order, with which builds, is DELIBERATELY NOT DECIDED YET (plan §2.24 fixed the mechanism
and left the contents open), so nothing below is balance or an intended run.
It is DISABLED by "weight": 0 - the rotation drops entries at or below zero, exactly the way
the wild species pool does. That matters more here than it does for the payout example: biomes
are eligible simply by existing, so an enabled example file would send real runs to an arena
build that does not exist. Delete this file, or shadow this path from your own datapack.
One biome per file. The id is the file path: this one is 'cobblemon_roguelite:example', and a
file at .../biomes/volcano/summit.json in namespace 'ns' would be 'ns:volcano/summit'.
Any field whose name starts with '_' is ignored, which is where comments go. Every other
unknown field is an error, so a typo is reported instead of silently taking a default.
_display_name: What the player is told they arrived in. Free text; there is no language file.
_arena_template: The build stamped into the arena while the run is here - data/<ns>/structure/<path>.nbt, the
same kind of id as ArenaTemplates.default. A run in a biome uses THIS instead of the wave-band
template in the arena config, which is what stops a server having two answers to 'what does
wave 40 look like'. Nothing ships at the id below.
_minecraft_biome: The biome the arena box is repainted to, which is the half a player actually feels: sky colour,
fog, water and grass tint, ambient loops, biome music. Any registered biome id, including one
from a datapack or another mod. Not checked at load - the biome registry is built by the same
reload this file is read in - so a wrong id is reported when the repaint runs.
_min_wave: Which waves this biome may be entered on. A run changes biome every 10 waves by default, and
the bounds are what make that a progression rather than a shuffle: without them the endgame's
biome is as likely at wave 1 as at wave 190. Both are optional - min_wave defaults to 1 and
max_wave to unbounded, i.e. 'anywhere in the run'.
_weight: Relative likelihood among the biomes eligible for a band. Zero or less disables the entry
without deleting it, which is why this example never appears in anybody's run.
